title: Antiseizure medication interactions
scopeNotes: Selected interactions relevant to stroke and inpatient care — not a complete interaction checker

entries.title: Carbamazepine or phenytoin with apixaban or rivaroxaban
mechanism: Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 induction
management: Avoid the combination (both labels name carbamazepine and phenytoin)
pearls: Fosphenytoin is a phenytoin prodrug — same interaction
sources: Eliquis (apixaban) US prescribing information. Bristol-Myers Squibb; revised 6/2026 (user-supplied label)
Xarelto (rivaroxaban) US prescribing information. Janssen; revised 3/2026 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Enzyme-inducing antiseizure medications with warfarin
management: Monitor INR closely when starting, stopping or changing the dose of the inducer
sources: Warfarin sodium tablets US prescribing information (RemedyRepack); revised 10/2026 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Carbapenems with valproate
effect: Clinically significant ↓ valproate level → loss of seizure control
management: Monitor valproate levels frequently after starting a carbapenem
If levels drop significantly or seizures worsen, change the antibiotic or the antiseizure medication
sources: Valproic acid oral solution US prescribing information. Atlantic Biologicals; revised 5/2024 (user-supplied label)

entries.title: Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole with phenytoin
sources: 2023 American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria Update Expert Panel. American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc 2023;71:2052-2081. doi:10.1111/jgs.18372

entries.title: Gabapentin or pregabalin with opioids
effect: ↑ severe sedation-related adverse events, including respiratory depression and death
management: Avoid, except when transitioning from opioids to a gabapentinoid or using a gabapentinoid to reduce opioid dose — then use caution
sources: 2023 American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria Update Expert Panel. American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc 2023;71:2052-2081. doi:10.1111/jgs.18372

entries.title: Three or more CNS-active drugs including antiseizure medications
effect: ↑ falls and fractures with ≥3 CNS-active drugs
management: Avoid ≥3 together; minimize the number of CNS-active drugs
sources: 2023 American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria Update Expert Panel. American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc 2023;71:2052-2081. doi:10.1111/jgs.18372
